detail.longDescription: I have three web apps. Located in the directories appA , appB and appC . However, application A uses some files from ../appB , and application B includes some files (a different set) from ../appC . I want all three directories appA , appB and appC to be git repos for these three apps. (These were not version controlled until now) And now I have a problem. Let's assume that application A requires ../appB/file1 and ../appB/file2 (it literally refers to the files with these paths). Is it possible to somehow include these two files in both repos for applications A and B? So that when I clone/pull the repo A, these two files also get installed (in a proper directory), along with other files for app A, and when I clone/pull repo B, these two files get installed along with other files for app B? In other words, git clone repoA should produce: somefile1 somefile2 ... ../appB/file1 ../appB/file2 and git clone repoB should produce: somefilea somefileb ... file1 file2 If it is possible, please tell me how.
